ROBOTS: https://www.rockettstgeorge.co.uk/robots.txt fetched FIRST. It is the standard Shopify agent-aware file - a single 'User-agent: *' group with 'Allow: /' plus disallows for /admin, /cart, /checkout(s), /orders, /account, /services, /sf_*, /cart.js, /recommendations/products and the sort_by / multi-filter crawl traps. TREE (beyond the nav): the full collection list was swept via /collections.json?limit=250 over 2 pages = 336 collections, filtered with a bath|shower|toilet|wc|basin|sink|vanity|mirror|soap|towel|tap|faucet|sanitary regex over handle+title. That surfaced exactly three genuine bathroom collections - bathroom, bathroom-mirrors, bathroom-lighting - plus the textile node bathmats-towels, the empty curtains-shower-curtains node and three styling edits. 'Bathroom Mirrors' is not in the mega-menu but IS linked from the Bathroom category page's own body copy (), renders h1 'Bathroom Mirrors' and holds 3 live products, so it is recorded as a Bathroom leaf per rule 10 (bathroom mirrors must never be skipped). It is NOT a subset of /collections/bathroom (product-id sets compared: only 1 of its 3 products, 'Small Pretty Gold Hanging Mirror', also sits in the Bathroom collection), so /collections/bathroom is not a parent URL being recorded over its children - the two are sibling listings and both are recorded under a 'Bathroom' grouping row. QTY: the Shopify global /collections.json products_count is WILDLY INFLATED on this store (the same defect the Furniture pass flagged: it reports bathroom=160 vs the real 44, bathroom-mirrors=17 vs 3, bathroom-lighting=3 vs 1) and was NOT used for any number. Every qty comes from four mutually-agreeing reads on the collection page itself: (1) the rendered header "You're viewing 1-N of N products", (2) the filter-bar "N Results", (3) the theme attribute data-collection-products-count, (4) exhaustive paging of /collections//products.json?limit=250 counting unique product ids. All four agreed on every node: Bathroom 44/44/44/44, Bathroom Mirrors 3/3/3/3, Bathroom Lighting 1/1/1/1, Bath Mats & Towels 9/9/9/9.
